verdict.rationale: Cake explicitly offers a 409A valuation delivered by expert appraisers within 3 business days, included in the cap table plan and referenced in pricing tiers, implying it is generated from live cap table data. However, there is no evidence of 'audit-ready' certification detail, no mention of scheduled/recurring refresh cadence, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the valuation process or its accuracy. missing for 10: explicit audit-ready packaging/documentation, automatic refresh scheduling, independent verification of valuation quality/turnaround.
